page.layout: One printed page with running text above and below an errata list; a heading "Errata quaedam..." set in larger type, followed by lines of the errata list; below it the word FINIS centred. Page number at top left (65). Show-through from the reverse side is ignored.

main_text.p: tam exiguo tempore potest emetiri, ita rectè concludi, Caelo huic Motum nequiquam convenire. Verum contrà, cujus ambitus ut sexto Millianum Germanicorum, in tempore decimamtextam Mil. haec partem (quantam corpus quodlibet Aere conficere potest) per-transitur offendit: adeoque motus rectus Motum Divinum competere Ioh.
main_text.head: Errata quaedam Lector Benevolus sic corrigat.
main_text.l: Pag.23. tit. in Figuram Coeli Ptolemaicam.
Pag.42. lin.7. sine. in quibusdam exemplaribus.
main_text.p: Hanc scriptum Lectorem sic in Domino ... Amen.
